correctedDiagnoses: D-238 named N2's 12 rejections a missing limb exit in the outfit check. Wrong: a remnant of the limb's contour hung 7 rows below the cuff (fabric-coloured antialias the D-232 limb exit kept, left detached when the ink between was removed); the check saw sleeve – arm – sleeve and was right. Corrected in the extraction, not by an exception in the check

D-238 named MF-2 (N3) an extraction fault of the black trousers. Wrong: their outline there lies over C's base-top corner (another category's base, never taken); the tank leaves that corner open, and the same notch is there with the pilot's navy shorts. The picture of the top lacks the fabric: marked (COMBO-6, F-014, F-015), not filled

D-238's MF-1 had two parts: (a) the hem contour mixed with the picture's shaded skin (F-001's mechanism) — an extraction fault, corrected; (b) C's ankle between a full-length hem and a low sneaker's front collar — a real gap, now checked (COMBO-5)
